test_title: PYST 6: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cd8a97e04c8887fc153df9ae2c32077c026d742dd8261369542440b5f0dc44a.png]
solution:
Logic: In every step a new character is added from the left, and the same sequence of characters are maintained in the next step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b23ef6e786776479c3bafdaa4a1496fd3458d64dc9265ff09c04c09ced0d001.png] 

Therefore, the figure in option 2 replaces the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
